text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Oguri-san, I have made up my mind. —To 
celebrate your birth, let us ascend to the 
heights together!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Awaiting past the trials is a sculpted, 
robust body of meat! Er, brawn! That is 
truly a gift befitting Oguri-san!"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Bracing oneself... and facing a thick, 
hearty slab of... meat, you say?!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Today, I shall guide you to a special 
hidden spot deep in the mountains!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Standing under waterfalls, toughening your 
fists, confronting deer... It will 
undoubtedly serve as excellent 
nourishment!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Deer... I see. I hear it's quite lean and 
refreshing.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
L-Light and refreshing!? Could it be that 
to you, Oguri-san, it's completely bland 
and unsatisfying...!?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Then, a wild boar... No, a bear!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Such raw ferocity—pure wildness itself. 
More than a worthy opponent, I'd say!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Wild boars, bears...! Hehe, looks like I 
can face them head-on with full force!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Such fighting spirit... truly worthy of 
Oguri-san. Now then, let us strike down 
our foes together, and then—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Let us savor every last bit...!
